verdicts.why: Homecoming: Pepper and Tony are back together; she runs the press conference, and when Peter turns it down Tony asks Happy for the ring to propose publicly. Text and card lines are true.

value.title: Avengers: Infinity War
value.text: Tony tells Pepper of a dream that they had a child named Morgan, then rushes off with Doctor Strange and ends up on an alien ship as she begs him to come home.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Pepper's fiancé, who ends up on an alien ship as she begs him home.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's fiancée, who begs him to come home.

verdicts.why: They do deal with each other (Central Park dream talk, Strange's arrival, her call as he is on the Q-Ship), but 'their future child, Morgan' states as fact what only Endgame shows; in Infinity War it is only a dream.

value.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
value.text: In a flashback to young Peter's Christmas with the Ravagers, Yondu kicks over his tree, then finds the present Peter got him and secretly leaves him the pair of blasters he still carries.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Quill's foster father, who gives him his blasters one Christmas.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Yondu's foster son, given his blasters one Christmas.

verdicts.why: The animated flashback is real: Yondu kicks the tree away, then finds Peter's gift to him and leaves two Quad Blasters on his bed. But it is not shown as his 'first' Christmas, and the blaster gift is Quill's telling, not Kraglin's story.
WandaVision#8's real flashback to 1999 Sokovia: the shell kills their parents, Pietro leads Wanda under the bed, and they wait two days facing the unexploded Stark shell.
Endgame: 2014 Thanos brings his forces forward, summons Proxima and the Black Order to the Compound ruins, she leads his army in the charge and is dusted by Tony's snap with the rest of his forces.

value.title: Avengers: Endgame
value.text: Back from the Blip, Shuri comes home to Wakanda and reunites with her mother at the Citadel as Birnin Zana celebrates.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Ramonda's daughter, back from the Blip.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Shuri's mother, who welcomes her home from the Blip.

verdicts.why: The reunion is on screen (Shuri and T'Challa reunite with Ramonda at the Citadel after the Blip), but Ramonda ruling Wakanda during the Blip comes from a tie-in book (BPWFTOMS), not Endgame, where Okoye is shown speaking for Wakanda.

value.title: Avengers: Endgame
value.text: Back from the Blip, T'Challa comes home to Wakanda and reunites with his mother at the Citadel as Birnin Zana celebrates.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Ramonda's son, back from the Blip.
value.on_b_card_about_a: T'Challa's mother, who welcomes him home from the Blip.

verdicts.why: Same as the Shuri item: the Citadel reunion is on screen, but Ramonda ruling Wakanda during the Blip is cited only to a tie-in book, not the film.

In Vol. 2 Meredith appears only in the 1980 flashback with Ego, not with Peter; what happens in Peter's present is between Peter and Ego. A stage says what happens between the two people, and one only remembered gets no stage.

Fandom's claim that Sharon is on the phone with her aunt in Winter Soldier's hallway scene has no on-screen naming of Peggy, and the two are never on screen together there. Only what's on screen counts.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#2
value.text: May wakes from the healing pod to find a Life Model Decoy of Coulson and tells him he is not Coulson, since the real one is still dead. She keeps him at a distance as they work together again.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A Life Model Decoy of May's old love, whom she won't treat as Coulson.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's old partner, who won't treat him as the real Coulson.

verdicts.why: The app already puts the S7 Chronicom LMD's stages on phil-coulson ties (Sousa S7#3, Sibyl S7#6/S7#13, Nathaniel S7#10, Enoch S7#9), so the S7 stage belongs on this tie. In S7#2 Coulson stops an erratic May and she is cold to him; they then work missions together and never rekindle the romance, so friend fits.

Ralph Bohner, under Agatha's spell, is the one posing as Pietro; the real Pietro does nothing with Wanda in Westview. The app has no Ralph Bohner file, and Pietro's own card already notes the impostor, so no stage goes on this tie.
Infinity War: T'Challa tasks Shuri with helping the Avengers, and she works to extract the Mind Stone from Vision while he and the Wakandan forces hold off Thanos's army.
Endgame: Shuri walks with T'Challa and Okoye through the portal into the Battle of Earth, fights there, and the two return to Wakanda to reunite with Ramonda.
Far From Home: Talos and Soren pose as Fury and Hill throughout the Elemental crisis; in the post-credits scene Soren tells Talos he has to tell Fury, and he calls him.
Endgame: Hope and Scott go to Jim Paxton's house to reunite with a five-years-older Cassie, and the three sit outside watching the fireworks. Friend is kept since family starts at Quantumania.

value.title: X2
value.text: Raven joins the X-Men to find the captive Xavier, then, posing as Stryker, has Jason turn Xavier's power, through Stryker's copy of Cerebro, against every human on Earth.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Uses him as a weapon against humanity while posing as Stryker.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The captive she turns against every human.

verdicts.why: They do deal with each other (Mystique, posing as Stryker, commands Jason to turn the captive Xavier's power on humans), but the machine at Alkali Lake is Stryker's second Cerebro, not Xavier's.
Deadpool & Wolverine: Negasonic comes to Wade's surprise birthday party with Yukio and Colossus, and a few days later they all gather again for dinner; Yukio is still credited as her girlfriend.

value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#65
value.text: Cable, a soldier from the future, recruits Scott and the X-Men on his mission to destroy Apocalypse's Lazarus Chamber, the source of his immortality.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A soldier from the future who recruits Scott to fight Apocalypse.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The X-Men's leader, who joins Cable's mission against Apocalypse.

verdicts.why: Cable and Scott do fight Apocalypse together, but they start dealing with each other in Part 3 (#65 in the app's numbering): Cable steals a time machine and recruits the X-Men, Cyclops among them, to destroy the Lazarus Chamber. The stage starts there. This is the same one stage as item 19.

The rules don't say which cut counts. In the theatrical cut Rogue is only a cameo at the end; the Bobby rescue and death happen only in The Rogue Cut. The owner has an open question about the No Way Home extended cut that matches this one.

value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#65
value.text: Cable, a soldier from the future, recruits Scott and the X-Men on his mission to destroy Apocalypse's Lazarus Chamber, the source of his immortality.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A soldier from the future who recruits Scott to fight Apocalypse.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The X-Men's leader, who joins Cable's mission against Apocalypse.

verdicts.why: Yes. In the app's numbering (episodes_verified: Part 3 is #65, Part 4 is #66), Part 3 is where Cable recruits the X-Men, Cyclops featured, to destroy the Lazarus Chamber. One stage only: the same value as item 17's amend, replacing the #66 proposal.

S5#18 is #106 (88 episodes in S1 to S4 plus 18), so the tie already has this episode. index.html's epSeas() maps a season episode to the whole-show number ('a tick in either counts for the other'). No new stage.

Rise of the Silver Surfer: the Surfer interrupts Sue's wedding, Johnny chases him and comes back with power-swapping; in Shanghai Doom impales Sue, and Johnny takes the team's combined powers and beats Doom.

Ben is dead here and appears only in Marko's flashback of the shooting, without Peter; the hunt and the forgiveness are between Peter and Marko. A stage says what happens between the two people, and this is consistent with the Meredith, May/Ben and Laura items.
Spider-Man 2: Harry's tritium deal has Octavius use Peter, Octavius kidnaps Mary Jane to coerce Peter, and Harry, once Peter persuades him, leads Peter to Octavius's lair to save her.

The Amazing Spider-Man 2 opens with Richard leaving young Peter at Ben and May's home with only 'Be good'; later May tells Peter his father was a man on the run whose research was worth a lot of money.
The Amazing Spider-Man 2's opening: at Ben and May's home, Mary goes over last-minute notes about Peter with them before she and Richard leave.

Across the Spider-Verse: Miles is late to the party for Jeff's promotion to police captain, his parents extend his punishment after he runs off with Gwen, and Gwen later promises Rio and Jeff she will bring him back.
Laura's Logan is dead and is only remembered, through his grave, TVA footage and Laura's words to a variant. Nothing happens between the two of them in this title.
Matt does not appear; his death is only mentioned by Gambit, and Elektra brushes it off. One only mentioned gets no stage.
Ben is dead and appears only in Marko's flashback; May learns the truth from Captain Stacy along with Peter and only remembers Ben. Nothing happens between them, the same as item 22.
